submissions.decision-passing-loop-charter-packing: WITH plans(bid_list, fee_cents, awards) AS (SELECT bid_id, fee_cents, 1 FROM charter_bid UNION ALL SELECT a.bid_id || ',' || b.bid_id, a.fee_cents + b.fee_cents, 2 FROM charter_bid AS a JOIN charter_bid AS b ON a.release_min <= b.arrive_min) SELECT p.bid_list, p.fee_cents, n.notice_id FROM plans AS p JOIN loop_notice AS n ON p.awards <= n.award_cap ORDER BY p.fee_cents DESC, p.awards ASC, p.bid_list COLLATE BINARY ASC LIMIT 1
submissions.decision-place-a-relief-trip-in-a-servic: SELECT o.offer_code, o.route_code, o.relief_min, g.arrival_rate * (o.relief_min - g.left_min) * (g.right_min - o.relief_min) AS saved_rider_min, g.source_id FROM relief_offer AS o JOIN gap_survey AS g ON g.route_code = o.route_code AND o.relief_min BETWEEN g.left_min + 3 AND g.right_min - 3 ORDER BY saved_rider_min DESC, o.offer_code COLLATE BINARY ASC LIMIT 1
submissions.decision-plan-two-coupon-redemptions: WITH choices(coupon, stock, first_cents, second_cents) AS (SELECT campaign_id, stock, first_cents, second_cents FROM campaigns WHERE stock >= 1 UNION ALL SELECT '-', 2, 0, 0) SELECT a.coupon AS first_coupon, b.coupon AS second_coupon, a.first_cents + b.second_cents AS saved_cents FROM choices AS a CROSS JOIN choices AS b WHERE (a.coupon <> b.coupon OR a.stock >= 2) AND NOT (a.coupon = 'A' AND b.coupon = 'B') AND NOT (a.coupon = 'B' AND b.coupon = 'A') ORDER BY saved_cents DESC, a.coupon COLLATE BINARY ASC, b.coupon COLLATE BINARY ASC LIMIT 1
submissions.decision-platform-amendment-at-departure: WITH ranked AS (SELECT d.trip_id, b.platform_code, b.source_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.trip_id ORDER BY b.posted_min DESC, b.source_id COLLATE BINARY ASC) AS priority FROM departure_board AS d JOIN platform_bulletin AS b ON b.route_code = d.route_code AND b.posted_min <= d.depart_min AND b.open_min <= d.depart_min AND (b.close_min IS NULL OR d.depart_min < b.close_min)) SELECT trip_id, platform_code, source_id FROM ranked WHERE priority = 1 ORDER BY trip_id ASC
